results.name: Registry: two coral r 11 one-hit roses, one group, 46 px apart, with a hint of 52 characters or fewer
Placements: L9 W3 debuts one pair with its hint; pairs recur in W5, W7, W9 and a W8 drop; W1 and W10 stay clear
A credited touch blushes one rose: no damage, refund, split charge or sun, and a heart ring on its sweetheart
A kiss: the sweetheart touched within 1.2 s blooms both, refunds both to that seed and pays +1 sun and 300 x tempo
A Cupid shot: one seed that blushes one rose and ricochets into the other pays +2 sun and 600 x tempo
A blush runs out at exactly 1.2 s of foe time (a pout) and the pair resets; a Lullaby holds it
A kiss or a chain in a blush's last moment opens both quietly: the rose waiting to follow never pouts
Chains, powers and uncredited strikes are plain, and its sweetheart always blooms with it
A missed pair costs one life, not two; a lone pair holds its wave open
Real seeds: a double tap at the pair kisses, and a split seed can take both
The bot: an idle rose is worth a little, its sweetheart a lot while it blushes or a seed flies at it, a blushing rose nothing
foes.js never touches the seed pod and never uses Math.random
The roses draw cheaply: finite, balanced, no gradient, shadow or surface once warm, and the blush and its arc at every quality
